title: Serialise the signed-audit tests with the env swaps that move their HMAC key
goal: Fix the intermittent susi-sandbox-client test audit_retention_prune_full_segment_rotates_and_attests (found by the full Linux workspace run) at its root: every test that writes or verifies signed audit records holds the crate's env lock.

decisions.root_cause: The audit chain's HMAC key is read from SusiDirs::substrate_home()/audit.hmac.key, which follows the process's SUSI_HOME. sandbox_service_client_routes_all_five_endpoints_and_honors_local_override swaps SUSI_HOME under crate::env_test_lock(), but nine tests that sign (SusiAuditLogger::log_event, append_signed_entry) or verify (verify_chain) records did not take that lock, so a record could be signed under one home's key and verified, or chained, under another's. signed_entries_verify_and_detect_tamper already held the lock for exactly this reason.
decisions.fix: The lock is taken by the five audit_payload_free_policy tests that log events, the three audit_retention_prune tests that log events, and append_waits_for_the_cross_process_chain_lock. No assertion, bound or behaviour changed.
decisions.gemi_ceiling: The same full run failed lean_core_ceilings::pillar_source_does_not_grow on susi-gemi (21,305 > 21,290, from 364600b95). A fix was prepared here, but claudegemiceiling landed its own (e52dd0abb) first, so it was dropped and main's is kept.

results.host: CachyOS Linux x86_64, busy shared laptop; tests with throwaway HOME/XDG_*/SUSI_HOME, *_API_KEY/HF_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN unset, CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME real
results.full_run: cargo test --offline --locked --workspace --no-fail-fast on e81099fef: 290 test binaries, 5,409 passed, 2 failed, 14 ignored, 5 min 52 s; the failures were this test and the susi-gemi line ceiling
results.repeat_before: susi-sandbox-client lib test binary, unmodified, 20 runs: 19 passed, 1 failed (audit_retention_prune_full_segment_rotates_and_attests)
results.repeat_after: same binary with the fix, 20 runs: 20 passed (60 tests each)
results.clippy: cargo clippy --offline --locked --all-targets -p susi-gemi -p susi-sandbox-client -- -D warnings: exit 0

limitations: The race is timing-dependent; 20 green runs bound but do not prove its absence. The fix follows the crate's documented rule for tests that read SusiDirs-derived paths.
